meta.title: Care Guide | Nafas Beauty Clinic
meta.description: Complete guide to pre and post care for filler and botox treatments

care.heading: Care Guide
care.description: Following these instructions will improve your treatment results

preCare.heading: Pre-Injection Instructions
preCare.description: Important tips before visiting for filler, botox and other beauty services
preCare.noAlcoholDesc: Avoid consuming alcohol at least 24 to 48 hours before your visit.
preCare.noBloodThinnersDesc: Avoid medications like aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, Vitamin E, omega-3 and some herbal supplements for 3 to 7 days before.
preCare.noHeavyExerciseDesc: On the day of your visit, avoid heavy exercise, sauna and hot baths.
preCare.discloseConditionsDesc: If you have active cold sores, infection, pregnancy, nursing, drug allergies or specific conditions, please inform the clinic before treatment.
preCare.drinkWaterDesc: Drinking plenty of water from one day before injection is recommended, especially for filler injection.

postCare.heading: Post-Filler Care
postCare.description: Important tips after filler injection to maintain results and prevent complications
postCare.noHeatDesc: Avoid exposing the treatment area to extreme heat such as solarium or sauna.
postCare.noAlcoholWeekDesc: Strictly avoid alcoholic beverages for one week.
postCare.noHeavyExercise48hDesc: Avoid heavy exercises for the first 48 hours.
postCare.takeCephalexinDesc: Take Cephalexin every 8 hours for three days.
postCare.vitaminCDesc: Take Vitamin C and water for one week.
postCare.contactDoctorDesc: If you experience severe pain or bruising in the first hours, inform your doctor immediately.

durability.heading: Filler Durability
durability.bodyCompatibilityDesc: Each brand is different. If someone had good results with a brand, it doesn't guarantee the same for you.
durability.areaDurabilityDesc: High-use areas like lips have less durability than chin, and smile line durability is less than angle filler.
durability.aftercareImportanceDesc: Durability depends on your care and following post-injection instructions.
durability.firstTimerNoteDesc: First-time patients need a 20-day adaptation period for the gel to adjust. Gel absorption is natural and you need at least two sessions for desired results.
